<div class="summary">
<strong>`r hours_format(result$total / 1e6, 2)` million hours</strong> of estimated fishing activity across
<strong>`r hours_format(result$active)` active grid cells</strong> in 2023.

## T01 · Annual grid map {#t01}

```{r map}
knitr::include_graphics(result$paths[["T01"]])
```

The highest-hour grid was centred at **`r sprintf("%.2f° E, %.2f° N", peak$lon_center, peak$lat_center)`** near the coast of eastern China, with **`r hours_format(peak$fishing_hours, 2)` hours**. The Northwest Pacific accounts for a large share of the global total, as the regional comparison below quantifies. Of the `r hours_format(result$observed)` grid cells recorded in the dataset, `r hours_format(result$zero)` had zero estimated fishing hours.

## T02 · FAO marine area totals {#t02}

```{r areas}
knitr::include_graphics(result$paths[["T02"]])
```

The **Northwest Pacific (61)** recorded **`r hours_format(matched$fishing_hours[1] / 1e6, 2)` million hours**, or **`r percent_format(matched$share_of_global[1])` of the global total**. The **Northeast Atlantic (27)** and **Western Indian Ocean (51)** followed with `r hours_format(matched$fishing_hours[2] / 1e6, 2)` and `r hours_format(matched$fishing_hours[3] / 1e6, 2)` million hours, respectively. The global denominator includes `r hours_format(unmatched$fishing_hours / 1e6, 2)` million hours (`r percent_format(unmatched$share_of_global)`) from grid centres outside the FAO marine polygons.

## T03 · Fishing-hour concentration {#t03}

```{r concentration}
knitr::include_graphics(result$paths[["T03"]])
```

```{r concentration-table}
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  "Top share of active grids" = paste0(result$cutoffs$top_grid_percent, "%"),
  "Grid count" = hours_format(result$cutoffs$grids),
  "Cumulative hours" = hours_format(result$cutoffs$fishing_hours, 2),
  "Share of global hours" = percent_format(result$cutoffs$hours_fraction),
  check.names = FALSE), align = "lrrr")
```

Ranking is based on annual hours, with ties ordered by `grid_id`. A cell is active if its annual hours are positive. Each cutoff rounds up to a whole grid, and the cumulative curve ends at 100%. Shares describe a percentage of **active grid cells**. The physical area of a 0.1° cell varies by latitude.

## Sources and interpretation

Global Fishing Watch estimates apparent fishing activity from AIS observations. AIS reception and classification vary by location. Report the results as **estimated hours in the observed data**. The regional chart compares total hours and does not adjust for region size.

- [Global Fishing Watch v3.0 dataset and documentation](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.14982712)
- [FAO marine fishing areas](https://www.fao.org/cwp-on-fishery-statistics/handbook/general-concepts/main-water-areas)
- [Natural Earth land polygons](https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/110m-physical-vectors/110m-land/)
